svg.text: 🔴 Staff is a Coordinator — any urgency

Staff (coordinator) iCare created — HR & Management notified
Coordinator submits own action plan + evidence

Coordinator cannot see their own iCare via excludeStaffEmployeeNumber query filter.
Identical email recipients to High/Critical flow: Staff · HR · Management (coordinator responsible skipped).
